# Advisories the dependency-audit CI job may ignore, one per line:
#
#   ADVISORY-ID  PACKAGE  REVIEW-BY(YYYY-MM-DD)  REASON...
#
# Every other advisory against uv.lock fails CI. An entry whose REVIEW-BY date
# has passed ALSO fails CI, so nothing stays ignored by default: on or before
# that date, re-check whether the blocker is gone (uv lock --upgrade-package
# <blocker> --dry-run, and the blocker's newest release on PyPI) and either fix
# it or renew the entry with today's findings. REVIEW-BY is at most 30 days out.
# IDs may be the CVE or the GHSA alias; pip-audit matches either.
#
# Checked 2026-11-20: pr-agent 0.50.0 is its newest release and pins
# litellm==1.105.1 and opentelemetry-api==1.45.1 exactly. litellm 1.105.1
# requires filelock<4; litellm 1.110.2 (newest) allows filelock<5, but pr-agent
# holds litellm back. `uv lock --upgrade-package {litellm,pr-agent,filelock,
# opentelemetry-api} --dry-run` each report "No lockfile changes". Fix = a
# pr-agent release that lifts those pins (or dropping/overriding pr-agent,
# an owner decision).
